changes.title: Ley after boot
items: The ley line to the first runestone no longer shows before the boot: it branches off the home ring as the boot's pulse goes past where it leaves it (about a third of the way round), its tip running out to the first stone as the boot finishes the ring.

changes.title: Wave fireworks
items: When a wave reaches an area you've already cleared, fireworks burst over its soundsystem, and from then on its lasers stay on: full party

changes.title: Sparkler fizz
items: Fly close to the ley line's pulse and you can hear it fizz and crackle like a sparkler
